info.name: Get user account top video pins analytics

params.name: start_date
params.description: Metric report start date (UTC). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Cannot be more than 90 days back from today.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Metric report end date (UTC). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Cannot be more than 90 days past start_date.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Specify sorting order for video metrics

params.name: from_claimed_content
params.description: Filter on Pins that match your claimed domain.

params.name: pin_format
params.description: Pin formats to get data for, default is all.

params.name: app_types
params.description: Apps or devices to get data for, default is all.

params.name: content_type
params.description: Filter to paid or organic data. Default is all.

params.name: source
params.description: Filter to activity from Pins created and saved by your, or activity created and saved by others from your claimed accounts

params.name: metric_types
params.description: Metric types to get video data for, default is all.

params.name: num_of_pins
params.description: Number of pins to include, default is 10. Max is 50.

params.name: created_in_last_n_days
params.description: Get metrics for pins created in the last "n" days.

params.name: ad_account_id
params.description: Unique identifier of an ad account.

items.docs:
Gets analytics data about a user's top video pins (limited to the top 50).
- By default, the "operation user_account" is the token user_account.

Optional: Business Access: Specify an ad_account_id to use the owner of that ad_account as the "operation user_account".
